branches.rule: Each package keeps its branch and checkout. Sync the accepted common baseline from main before using new bindings; record exact synchronized common base SHA and use it as check-changes --base. Own paths only. Never overwrite team branch work; propose shared changes to R01.
branches.base: initial activation commit, or a later accepted shared baseline explicitly synchronized from main (record its exact SHA)

isolation.test_database: temporary directory per test, in-memory only for replay/neutral mock
isolation.ports: loopback, default 0 (OS assigned), print actual port
isolation.browser: fresh synthetic browser context per test; runtime owner implements and tests actual browser isolation
isolation.logs: local .local/ or temp directory; do not commit cookies/credentials; selected sanitized evidence in owner-owned tests/evidence subdirectory
isolation.live: no live execution; LR_ENVIRONMENT other than mock rejected in bootstrap; no external requests by provided stub servers; this is not full network sandbox enforcement

stub_contract: Pinned replay fixtures are examples, not product state machines, trusted evidence, actual authentication, or proof of schema semantic validity. RT fixtures only represent documented boundaries, not permission bypass. Neutral mock is not platform-specific and contains no real credentials. Product implementations must replace and pass actual contract/gate tests.
